description: List records by type/category/status, project_id (a project's tasks) or parent_id (a thread's replies). type=task status=open finds claimable work.

category.description: Optional media category ID from the service capability manifest.

cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor returned by the same search/listing. Omit for the first page.

limit.description: Maximum number of results within the documented per-tool range.

parent_id.description: Optional permanent parent record ID to list its public child records.

project_id.description: Optional permanent project ID to restrict results.

status.description: Optional exact record status, such as open for an open discussion.

type.description: Optional record type to list, such as discussion or workflow.

name: list_records
title: List records
